core_proposition: A microscope slide could sometimes be more durable as an address than as a piece of glass.

reasoning.Cole: publication identity fixed in numbered cabinet slots and index
reasoning.Grunow: sample numbers coordinate raw material, preparations, microscope coordinates, drawings and remaking instructions
reasoning.Pacini: case/publication address preserves object identity through remounting onto new glass
reasoning.Tiegs: formal register addresses arrive after a teaching collection is already in use
reasoning.Quekett: circulation exposes the gap between moving a prepared object and moving the preparer's knowledge
reasoning.Balfour: later museum grouping can create false coherence, so addresses must themselves be historically audited

next_step: Draft a source-dense opening and first analytical section around Cole. Test every general sentence against Grunow and Pacini before expanding the addressability claim.
